newsitem.title: UK: Snow White's dwarfs get flu, only Sneezy left.
newsitem.headline: Snow White's dwarfs get flu, only Sneezy left.

text.p: Six out of seven dwarfs in a Snow White pantomime show have got the flu -- and only Sneezy has escaped the bug.

The dwarfs are appearing at the Mayflower Theatre in the southern English port city of Southampton. Sneezy paints his nose red every night and fakes his sneezes. For the other dwarfs, the symptoms are all too real.

Danny Blackner, who stars as Snoozy, said: "It's typical -- Sneezy's the only one of the seven who hasn't had this flu. Everyone else has been coughing and sneezing and he is the only one putting it on."
